title: The Hate U Give
author: Angie Thomas
summary: Sixteen-year-old Starr moves between her poor Black neighbourhood and her mostly white prep school. When she witnesses a police officer shoot an unarmed childhood friend, she has to decide whether to speak up.
readIf: you want a powerful, readable novel about family, identity and finding your voice in public.
skipIf: you want an escape from difficult real-world issues.

pairings.reason: A classic about racial injustice seen through a young person's eyes, with a more distant historical setting.
A bleak classic of how racism shapes a young Black man's life.
Another young adult story about a girl deciding whether to tell what she saw.
